invariants.rule: A valid false_positive verdict closes before proposal or execution.
Judge output cannot add actions, waive evidence, raise severity or replace approval.
Every action is revalidated against UseCase.actions immediately before execution.
Consequential external actions require explicit approval and configured authenticated service.
An action is successful only after outcome verification; failures retry within bounds and may compensate.
GitHub Pages performs no removed API call and exposes external actions as unavailable.
